items.title: Bolt Forge
items.name: Bolt Forge
items.summary: Bolt's new agent with open-source models and 50X usage
items.description: Bolt Forge is a new agent inside Bolt.new that runs on open-source models. Every Pro plan gets up to 50X more usage with no daily caps. Scores 91% of Bolt's top paid model on their internal benchmark.
top_comments:
Bolt Forge is a new agent inside Bolt.new that runs entirely on open-source models.

Sitting next to Standard and Max in the agent picker, this one is built only on open models - GLM 5.3 Flash and GLM 5.3 as the main pair, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek v4 Pro as experimental picks.

What makes it different: Every individual Pro plan gets up to 50X more usage on Forge, free, through Oct 14, 2026.

The trade is opt-in: your build sessions (prompts, code, fix traces) get anonymized and go toward training new open-weight models with Arcee AI, a US open-model lab. You can stop sharing anytime by switching back to Standard or Max.

Key features:

  • One monthly usage bar, no daily limits

  • Hits 100% → auto-switches to Standard, no overage

  • Scores 92.2 vs 101 for Bolt's top paid model on their internal benchmark (~91% capability)

  • Runs on WebContainers in-browser, no server cost

  • Duplicate your project before testing serious builds, still a research preview

Who it's for: Builders who burn through credits fast in the brainstorm/draft phase and want room to experiment without touching production usage.

P.S. I hunt the latest and greatest launches in tech, SaaS and AI, follow to be notified → @rohanrecommends

Question for the makers—right now it handles full-stack in the browser tab really well, but what’s the vision for connecting to existing local microservices or private databases during the prototyping phase?
Incredible work from the Bolt team. As far as I know, it's the first of the vibe-coding solutions to really go all in with open-source models, and I commend you!

items.title: ToneBird
items.name: ToneBird
items.summary: AI reply assistant that remembers your relationships
items.description: ToneBird is an AI reply assistant for Mac and Windows. It remembers your relationships, uses conversation history and connected files, and drafts replies in your voice inside Gmail, Slack, and other supported apps. You review and send.
top_comments: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I’m Lyn, GTM & PMM at ToneBird. We’re excited to share ToneBird, an AI reply assistant for something small that comes up every day: figuring out what to say back. Working on a launch means keeping a lot of conversations moving. A partner checking a deadline. A creator waiting for an answer. A teammate asking what changed. Even a short reply can take work before you type anything: finding the last conversation, remembering what you promised, and deciding how to say it without sounding too blunt or too formal. Taking that conversation to ChatGPT means explaining the whole situation again, then bringing the answer back. All that for a message that might only be two lines. Those little moments add up. That’s why we built ToneBird, and why we’re happy to finally put it in your hands. Here’s how it helps: • Remembers the relationship. Who you’re talking to, what you’ve promised, and where you left off. • Brings the context. Uses past conversations and connected files to help draft your next reply. • Keeps your voice. Adjusts the wording for the person and situation, so it still sounds like you. • Fits into your day. Works inside apps like Slack, iMessage, and more. You pick a draft, edit it, and decide what to send. Getting here took three launch postponements, late-night builds, and lots of user calls. We kept listening and making changes, and we’d love for you to help shape what comes next. 👉 https://tonebird.ai/download - try it on that message you’ve been putting off. If something feels off, leave a comment or email us at tonebirdmkt@amplift.ai. We’ll read your feedback and reply personally, with a little help from ToneBird ;) I’ll be here all day, so ask me anything: how it works, what we learned from user calls, or what we’re still figuring out. Happy to chat 🐦
can it talk trash to my enemies? 😆
'I'll get back to you tomorrow' is easy to type and easy to lose in a busy inbox. Turning that promise into something to follow up on makes a lot of sense！

items.title: Flicka
items.name: Flicka
items.summary: Launch-ready product demos, from a Chrome extension
items.description: A screen recorder that makes launch-ready demos: auto-zoom on your clicks, backdrops, frames, a webcam layer, MP4 export. A Chrome extension; nothing uploaded.Flicka is now a Chrome extension. Record a tab, your screen, a window, an area or your camera; draw and blur on the page while you record. Your clicks become zooms in the editor, with captions made on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
top_comments: Hi Product Hunt 👋 Last week we launched Flicka as a web app: a screen recorder that lives in a browser tab. We learned a lot, including why it had to become an extension. A web page can't draw on other pages. The moment you're recording, the thing you most want to do is point at something, circle it, or blur an email address, and a tab can't reach any of that. So Flicka 1.0 is a Chrome extension, and the recorder, library, and editor all live in it. What's new • One sentence is the whole recorder: "Record this tab with my mic and auto-zoom." Click a word to change it. • Draw, highlight, add arrows and text, and blur on the page while you record. Or hide the bar completely. • Tab, screen, window, a drawn area, or just your camera. • A take is saved as it records, so if Chrome crashes you get it back. • Word-by-word captions, made on your computer. Your audio is never sent anywhere. • Camera layouts that move: bubble, side by side, or camera only, eased on the timeline. Still true: nothing you record is uploaded, and no account is needed to record, edit, or export. It's free to use; Pro removes the watermark and adds MP4, 4K, captions, and the rest. Works in Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Arc on Mac and Windows. I'd love to know what you'd record with it, and what's missing.
Can you move or adjust the auto zooms after recording? That would be really useful.
The crash recovery part caught my attention. Losing a recording halfway through is the worst.

items.title: Flicka
items.name: Flicka
items.summary: Launch-ready product demos, from a Chrome extension
items.description: A screen recorder that makes launch-ready demos: auto-zoom on your clicks, backdrops, frames, a webcam layer, MP4 export. A Chrome extension; nothing uploaded.Flicka is now a Chrome extension. Record a tab, your screen, a window, an area or your camera; draw and blur on the page while you record. Your clicks become zooms in the editor, with captions made on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
top_comments: Hi Product Hunt 👋 Last week we launched Flicka as a web app: a screen recorder that lives in a browser tab. We learned a lot, including why it had to become an extension. A web page can't draw on other pages. The moment you're recording, the thing you most want to do is point at something, circle it, or blur an email address, and a tab can't reach any of that. So Flicka 1.0 is a Chrome extension, and the recorder, library, and editor all live in it. What's new • One sentence is the whole recorder: "Record this tab with my mic and auto-zoom." Click a word to change it. • Draw, highlight, add arrows and text, and blur on the page while you record. Or hide the bar completely. • Tab, screen, window, a drawn area, or just your camera. • A take is saved as it records, so if Chrome crashes you get it back. • Word-by-word captions, made on your computer. Your audio is never sent anywhere. • Camera layouts that move: bubble, side by side, or camera only, eased on the timeline. Still true: nothing you record is uploaded, and no account is needed to record, edit, or export. It's free to use; Pro removes the watermark and adds MP4, 4K, captions, and the rest. Works in Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Arc on Mac and Windows. I'd love to know what you'd record with it, and what's missing.
Can you move or adjust the auto zooms after recording? That would be really useful.
The crash recovery part caught my attention. Losing a recording halfway through is the worst.

idea_items.title: 供应链分析 Agent
idea_items.need_line: 供应链团队要做需求预测与补货决策，但补货规则和业务经验散落在 Excel 表格与个人判断中，难以变成模型可直接调用的输入。
idea_items.status_line: 目前主要靠 Excel、VBA、PowerQuery 处理需求预测和库存管理，辅以 Eviews、SPSS、Flexsim 等做统计与仿真，也出现了把供应链优化列为多场景之一的通用决策 Agent，但都绕开了经验数据化这一步。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是把补货规则、场景约束和业务经验转成模型可直接调用的结构化输入，让 Agent 在已有报表数据上做约束注入与补货方案对比，而不是再堆一个库存优化算法。

idea_items.title: 供应链仓储 AI 应用
idea_items.need_line: 中小企业的仓储补货与库存管理缺少贴合自身业务流程的预测和决策支持，只能靠人工经验和手工报表勉强维持。
idea_items.status_line: 目前主要用 Excel、VBA、PowerQuery 做需求预测和库存管理，补货按 JIT 加安全库存或周转天数反推，进阶做法依赖 SPSS、Eviews、MATLAB 等统计工具和 Flexsim、Supply Chain Guru 等仿真规划软件，而 EOQ、多级库存、概率补货这类模型基本没有进入实际流程。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得继续跟踪的是把外部市场约束和内部经验规则一起结构化进补货决策链路，形成能随业务调整、基于内部报表数据持续改参数的规则配置与数据沉淀层，而不是再叠加一层更复杂的库存优化模型。
tags: 供应链仓储 AI 应用

idea_items.title: 企业自动化工作流
idea_items.need_line: 非标设备项目从前期设计到后期调试高度依赖资深工程师和完整团队，需求确认、方案设计与验收变更反复返工，难以沉淀复用。
idea_items.status_line: 当前大家靠资深机械工程师和完整工程团队硬扛从前期设计到后期调试的全流程，把每台设备当独立研发来做；Product Hunt 上 Sai、Makersclaw 2.0 这类主打 agent 编排的产品也在用“自动化工作流”包装同一注意力，但尚未对上车间现场手工劳动和非标定制反复返工的痛点。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是把非标项目里“需求确认—方案设计—验收变更”这条链路上的条款、改动和影响面结构化沉淀下来，让下次类似客户能直接复用而不是从零重新研发。

high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 先做单实例自托管部署，跑通一条真实链路：用户提问后先检索长期记忆，再由单个 Agent 调用工具作答，并把本轮结果写回记忆。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: 项目仍处在较新的验证窗口；GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 1877；已有较强社区验证
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 腾讯开源的自托管多用户多 Agent AI 助手，本周热度近 1900 且社区验证强，可落到企业自动化工作流等产品化场景，今日最值得关注。

high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版先做单会话编码 Agent:Electron 窗口里选中本地仓库,Rust 宿主负责读写文件与跑命令,只接一个模型和一种插件加载方式。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 1381；已有较强社区验证

interest_sections.title: 供应链分析 Agent
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是补货自动化的瓶颈不在模型算法本身而在业务经验与外部变化无法数据化，Agent 的切入点应先把这些规则沉淀为可用输入，再谈自动补货。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前讨论集中在用 Excel/VBA/PowerQuery 处理需求预测与库存管理，辅以 Eviews、SPSS、Flexsim、Supply chain guru 做统计分析与仿真，GitHub 上 DecisionAgent 这类把供应链优化列为多场景之一的通用决策 agent 也已出现，但都绕开了经验数据化这一步。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把补货规则、场景约束和业务经验转成模型可直接调用的结构化输入，让 agent 在已有报表数据上做约束注入与补货方案对比，而不是再堆一个库存优化算法。

product_items.title: johnson7788/DecisionAgent
product_items.highlight_one_liner: 多场景辅助决策智能 Agent 系统
product_items.reuse_direction: 把「供应链分析 Agent / 企业自动化工作流」封装成更明确的岗位或任务入口
product_items.minimal_mvp: 先做一个面向 供应链分析 Agent 的轻量单任务工具

interest_sections.title: 供应链仓储 AI 应用
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，核心观察是供应链补货卡在业务经验无法数据化、系统也接不住这些经验，导致模型落不了地，需求正从追求更高级的补货算法转向把规则和经验先沉淀成系统可用的数据。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现有做法是中小企业用 Excel、VBA、PowerQuery 做需求预测和库存管理，补货流程复用 JIT+安全库存或周转天数反推，讨论中的进阶解法多落在 SPSS、Eviews、MATLAB 等统计工具和 Flexsim、Supply Chain Guru 等仿真规划软件上，而 EOQ、多级库存、概率补货这类模型基本停在实际流程之外。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是把外部市场约束和内部经验规则一起结构化进补货决策链路，做成能随业务调整、基于内部报表数据持续改参数的规则配置与数据沉淀层，而不是再叠加一层更复杂的库存优化模型。

interest_sections.title: 企业自动化工作流
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、Product Hunt，核心观察是制造与非标自动化被讨论的卡点不在技术可行性，而在需求难定、变更难控、经验难沉淀，而 agent 编排类产品目前只覆盖了后半段的抽象自动化叙事。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前大家靠资深机械工程师和完整工程团队硬扛从前期设计到后期调试的全流程，把每台设备当独立研发来做；Product Hunt 上 Sai、Makersclaw 2.0 这类主打 agent 编排的产品也在用“自动化工作流”包装同一注意力，但尚未对上车间现场手工劳动和非标定制反复返工的痛点。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把非标项目里“需求确认—方案设计—验收变更”这条链路上的条款、改动和影响面结构化沉淀下来，让下次类似客户能直接复用而不是从零重新研发。
